iEEGCoordinateSystemDescription: ICBM 2009a nonlinear symmetric template (1x1x1 mm), as stated by the source readme.
iEEGCoordinateProcessingDescription: Source: nonlinear coregistration (affine then nonlinear deformation) between each subject space (where contacts were identified) and the ICBM 2009a symmetric template, applied to native-space electrode positions. Each row is the MIDPOINT between the two contacts of a bipolar channel (rows are bipolar channels, not physical contacts). Coordinates copied unchanged from the source.
iEEGCoordinateProcessingReference: Frauscher B et al. (2018) Brain 141:1130-1144, doi:10.1093/brain/awy035; readme_MNI_Open_iEEG_Atlas.txt
